title: Voting agreements.
bodyText:
(a) Two or more members may provide for the manner in which they will vote by signing an agreement for that purpose. The agreements may be valid for a period of up to ten years.

(b) A voting agreement created under this section is specifically enforceable.
bodyHtml:
[§414D-117]  Voting agreements.  (a)  Two or more members may provide for the manner in which they will vote by signing an agreement for that purpose.  The agreements may be valid for a period of up to ten years.

     (b)  A voting agreement created under this section is specifically enforceable. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1]
